summary_1line: Amid horrific battlefield carnage, Drona assaults Yudhishthira; Satyajit and other allies resist but are slain as Drona devastates the Pandava forces.

image_candidates.scene_text: The battlefield lies choked with dead elephants and shattered chariots as wounded beasts run wild through a mire of blood and bodies.
Satyajit in his chariot cuts down Drona’s standard and rains arrows upon the aged preceptor while surrounding warriors cheer.
Drona releases a crescent-headed arrow that severs Satyajit’s head as the prince stands defiant in his chariot amid flying shafts.
